Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete retained TagX Home, About and Privacy/Data Ethics texts and non-substantive annotation-endpoint response were actually read in this new metadata phase. They explicitly offer commercial managed public-web data collection, cleaning, validation, schema mapping and delivery for AI training, via API and structured files/warehouse feeds. This supports a narrow data-collection supplier role; it does not establish a professional human-preference annotation workforce. The Home example is expressly illustrative, anonymous hosted testimonials are not independent customer confirmation, and advertised 500+ customers, 3000+ projects, 100+ in-house experts, record totals and uptime are unverified provider claims. The footer attributes the site to Inferentia L.L.C-FZ, which is a contracting/control lead rather than independently verified registration or ownership; retain one TagX/TagXData brand and no additional parent supplier count. Privacy/Data Ethics explicitly restricts the stated service to public, non-personal, unauthenticated/non-paywalled data. That published boundary and compliance marketing do not establish copyright/AI-training rights for a particular source, an executed customer license or independently audited security. The unusable annotation endpoint is access/scope evidence only, not proof that annotation is absent. This scoped available-primary offer/process/identity/limits audit supports supplier classification conditional on separate coordinator commercial/group metadata acceptance and import of the exact four already-three-role-passed own-subject facts. It creates no new scientific wording/PASS, expert-workforce credit, legal conclusion, performance endorsement or all-source-function closure.
